registration.title: A bivariate Poisson score grid
registration.what: A shared goal component for the two sides, which adds draws at every score.
registration.why: The standard way to add dependence between the two sides' goals.
registration.how: The term is fitted on the selection window with the draw boost refitted alongside.
registration.hypothesis: The term improves the exact-score probabilities.

expected.evidence: The final period had been looked at by earlier diagnostics, so this is strong historical evidence and not a blind test.

registration.success_criteria: The round's bar, on the log loss of the exact 90-minute score.

events.label: The term itself, on the selection window
events.meaningful: No. Zero was the best value of the term, so it was not scored on the final period.

events.reason: The low-score excess is real but is fewer goals in tight games, not dependence between the sides: the standard shapes point the wrong way.
